name: Garbage rat
description: Garbage rats were a tiny yet sleek scavenger race that tended to set up warrens within the rubbish wastes that had accumlated in dirtier, less frequented byways. A sentient animal, they carried sharp but primitive digging equipment on their backs and spoke with a chatter, openly hostile toward larger species with whom they felt little empathy.

data.name: Garbage rat
data.distinctions: Sleek shape; shrill chatter; glittering eyes
